pokedexEntries.x: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.

pokedexEntries.or: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.

pokedexEntries.y: It attacks with retractable horns. It throws a punch that’s the equivalent of the force of a hundred pro boxers.

pokedexEntries.as: It attacks with retractable horns. It throws a punch that’s the equivalent of the force of a hundred pro boxers.

pokedexEntries.su: An amazingly friendly Pokémon, but if left to itself, loneliness overcomes it, and it oozes gooey tears.

pokedexEntries.mo: It gets picked on because it’s meek. But then, whoever teased it gets to feel the full force of its horns and a good swatting from its thick tail.

pokedexEntries.us: It’s very friendly toward people. If you grow close to it, Goodra will hug you with its sticky, slime-covered body. Don’t get mad.

pokedexEntries.um: Underneath its slimy skin is a thick layer of fat, and the combination of the two makes enemies’ attacks slide right off.

pokedexEntries.sw: Sometimes it misunderstands instructions and appears dazed or bewildered. Many Trainers don’t mind, finding this behavior to be adorable.

pokedexEntries.sh: Its form of offense is forcefully stretching out its horns. The strikes land 100 times harder than any blow from a heavyweight boxer.

pokedexEntries.sc: It loves the rain. This mellow Pokémon can be seen walking around on the plains and in the mountains on rainy days.

pokedexEntries.vi: This Pokémon is uncontrollable when enraged. It rampages on and on, lashing its tail with enough power to send a dump truck flying.

pokedexEntries.za: This very friendly dragon Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.
